disclosed_decisions.thesis: Controller share gains with fast-growing enterprise and AI end markets, Nvidia and Google boot-drive customers, and record margins. Recaps the October 29 earnings review without a new plan.

disclosed_decisions.thesis: Loan tokenization adds efficiency; expanding beyond HELOCs. Q3 consumer loan volume of $5.12bn landed near the top of the $4.8-5.2bn guide, the RWA.xyz chart shows no drop-off, and week 43 recovered to $373m, up 85% annually. Plans to maintain the position until the November 12 report, then re-evaluate.
disclosed_decisions.concern: Heavy share-price decline, which he attributes likely to HELOC concerns and the crypto downtrend; weekly volume ticked down before week 43, possibly seasonal. Watches partner additions and the consumer-loan-volume guide.

disclosed_decisions.thesis: Photonics and communications semiconductor maker with 40% sequential data-center growth, owned and expanding fabs, a broad customer base, and its strongest guide ever (61% annual growth at the midpoint) while the stock sits near $235 versus a $418 June high. Profits grow faster than revenue; he expects MACOM to easily beat analysts' low-growth estimates and the market to possibly re-rate it as a higher-growth stock.
disclosed_decisions.concern: No concern stated. Financials are source-reported; the re-rating and analyst underestimation are his interpretations.

disclosed_decisions.thesis: Fast-growing agentic AI cloud moving up market, with guidance for over 50% revenue growth in 2027 and early inference-engine traction. New Agent Droplets, agent learning and data services, an inference router and a Bright Data partnership. Keen to hear management on inference growth at the next report.
disclosed_decisions.concern: Inference engine growth is off a small base; competes with hyperscalers, neoclouds and startups.

disclosed_decisions.thesis: Dragonfly inspection and metrology gaining traction and winning against larger incumbents like KLA; HBM inspection equipment; SK Hynix best partner award. Cites RBC's initiation ($400 target, 80% advanced-packaging growth).
disclosed_decisions.concern: Will re-evaluate based on the strength of the November 9 report. The RBC target and growth figure are an analyst's claims, not WPR's.
